# Official MEXC public Protobuf schema

Source: https://github.com/mexcdevelop/websocket-proto/tree/0c9c4f35dd0fadc3a46a350e909a93379d81e811

Pinned commit: 0c9c4f35dd0fadc3a46a350e909a93379d81e811. Files are unchanged upstream bytes under the supplied Apache-2.0 LICENSE. The upstream wrapper mentions private imports; the bounded public-only decoder implements only fields 305/308/309/315 and refuses private oneofs. No private schema implementation or exchange credentials are needed.
